'''''Quantum Collosus''''' was a passenger [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that traveled between [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], reverting out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] along several worlds on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. The ship was designed to be as sleek as the deep sea creature it was modeled after, and was considered one of the finest vessels of its type.<ref name="DP" />

It was in a cabin aboard the ''Quantum Collosus'' that [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] was ordained into the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]] by [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] in [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]].<ref name="DP" />
